title: 安田記念の後に・悔しさを胸に！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oguri won the Yasuda Kinen! I'm super bummed, but I trained so hard to beat her that it turned into a real fiery showdown!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And it looks like Yaeno gets it now! If Oguri wasn't such an awesome racer, none of us would be working so hard for our dreams! None of us would burn bright!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yaeno said my mindset reminded her of how she felt when she faced formidable opponents in the past. She says she's ready to run toward her dream once more!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I also realized something from today's race. Oguri may be my ultimate rival, but I also want to be her ultimate rival.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: To do that, I'm running in the Takarazuka Kinen next! Yaeno and Chiyono O are gonna be there too, so I can't wait for our dreams to clash!
